Per the file, the serialized payload is (per the file) exactly seven bytes: | Byte (per the file) range | Field | Description | |------------|---------------------|---------------------------------------| | 0 (per the file) | discriminator | 3 | | 1 | mode (per the file) | 0 = always create, 1 (per the file) = idempotent | | 2 | bump hint (per the file) | Bump for the ATA address | | 3..7 | acct length hint | unsigned 32-bit little-endian (per the file) integer | For bump and acct length hint, 0 means absent.
